Nel quotidiano la/il responsabile commerciale senior si occuperà di pianificare e implementare strategie commerciali, curare le relazioni con clienti e partner, partecipare a incontri di negoziazione e definire accordi di collaborazione. Sarà inoltre responsabile del monitoraggio dei risultati di vendita, dell’analisi dei dati di mercato e della predisposizione di report periodici a supporto delle decisioni strategiche. La persona nel ruolo collaborerà con i diversi dipartimenti aziendali per allineare le attività commerciali agli obiettivi di business e coordinare eventuali progetti speciali collegati allo sviluppo del settore water & energy. Qualifiche Il/la candidato/a dovrebbe possedere solide analytical skills per analizzare dati di vendita, tendenze di mercato e performance commerciali, supportando decisioni strategiche basate su evidenze. È richiesta esperienza in commercial management e business planning per definire piani commerciali, gestire il portafoglio clienti e sviluppare strategie di crescita sostenibile. Sono necessarie competenze in team management per coordinare e motivare il team commerciale, favorendo collaborazione, condivisione di obiettivi e sviluppo delle persone. Il/la candidato/a dovrebbe avere esperienza in contract management per gestire trattative, predisporre e revisionare contratti commerciali, garantendo conformità alle policy aziendali e alle normative vigenti. Costituiscono titolo preferenziale laurea in discipline economiche o gestionali, ottime capacità di comunicazione e negoziazione, orientamento al risultato, buona conoscenza dell’inglese e familiarità con strumenti digitali e CRM. Salva Segnala offerta di lavoro Pillar ha fornito un livello di retribuzione Questo livello è fornito da Pillar. La tua retribuzione effettiva sarà basata sulle tue competenze e la tua esperienza. Rivolgiti al tuo recruiter per saperne di più. Livello retribuzione di base 30.000,00 €/yr - 45.000,00 €/anno About Pillar Pillar is an Italian startup founded on February 13, 2025. In less than a year, we raised €15.2 million to revolutionize the construction industry, and we are growing fast. Our mission is to rebuild its foundations. Our ambition is to manage 1 in 3 construction sites in Europe. We are Italian, but with a European vision 🚀 The Italian construction industry is the backbone of the country's economy, involving nearly 5 million people, yet it is still managed with outdated tools. Pillar was built to solve this problem at its root. We have built an all-in-one platform that allows construction companies to oversee every job site and monitor profitability in real time. Why Join Us Now Until now, "marketing at Pillar" meant "marketing for Italy": one team, one market, no need to distinguish local from central. That's changing: we're standing up a central Growth/Marketing function (Paid, CRM & Lifecycle, SEO & Content). That means Italy needs its own owner for the first time, someone who takes on everything that has made the market work so far. What You'll Do In practice: Own the Italian marketing P&L: pipeline, CAC, and customer acquisition targets for the market. Define and execute the strategy to reach and overperform your country targets. Partner with the Paid vertical to create and localize campaigns, messaging, and budget allocation for Italy. Partner with CRM/Lifecycle to create and adapt nurture flows, segmentation, and lifecycle communication. Own local product marketing: positioning, messaging, and launches for Italy. Represent the voice of Italy in central planning - flag what doesn't translate, propose what should be built locally. Work with Sales to align marketing-generated pipeline with sales capacity and feedback. Work with the Product and Central teams to align local marketing needs with their priorities. Report on market performance and translate local learnings into inputs for the central growth roadmap. Your one goal: prove the market, build the engine, and leave behind a repeatable model for the countries that come next. Who We're Looking For We are looking for someone who can operate as a local owner and a central partner at the same time. You have experience owning marketing (or product marketing or demand generation) for a specific market/country, ideally in B2B SaaS or a sales-led business. You're comfortable working in a matrix structure, taking direction and frameworks from central functions while owning local execution and results. You think in metrics: CAC, ARR, pipeline, conversion, funnel, and you know how to tie local activity back to business outcomes. You have hands-on experience with at least one growth lever (paid, lifecycle/CRM, content/SEO, or product marketing) and enough fluency across the others to coordinate with specialists. You're comfortable with ambiguity; building a market from an early stage means the playbook isn't fully written yet. NICE TO HAVE: Background in construction, real estate, or another traditional/regulated B2B industry. Autonomy is required. Ownership is required. A growth mindset is required. Experience launching or scaling a product in a new country/market. How We Work at Pillar At Pillar, we row in the same direction: if one of us speeds up, we all do. We're ambitious, and we raise the bar and take ownership as we go. Pillar isn't for you if you want to be a mere executor, want clearly defined boundaries, are looking for already-perfect processes, a calm pace, or someone to tell you exactly what to do every day. A small, fast team where the distance between an idea and shipping it is short. Genuine autonomy and visibility; nobody here waits to be told what to do. What We Offer Competitive compensation : €30.000-€45.000, tailored to experience and expertise. Ownership: Real ownership of a critical growth area and collaboration with leadership and hands-on involvement. Growth: Meritocratic growth: impact = advancement. Location: Milan (Italy) or Barcelona (Spain); Languages: Native-level proficiency in Italian (C2) and professional working proficiency in English required. Spanish is a plus. Office: A role based in Milan or Barcelona, under Pillar’s applicable working model. Team: Offsite every 6 months. A dynamic, ambitious, and collaborative team focused on innovation and professional growth. Our Hiring Process Initial conversation alongside our Talent Acquisition specialists. Brief 30-45 min interview with a member of the Marketing Team. A final chat with our VP of Growth. If you are excited about the opportunity to shape marketing at Pillar and make a real impact, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now; we are looking forward to meeting you! 🚀 One last thing Pillar is hiring this person while all of that is still taking shape. Build the system behind the scale.
